title: Read the Plate
note: First hour after the rite closes. Cole runs his Operator constraint-perception lens against the chamber for the first time. He queries the System for his sheet. He spends 1 hp from his Lay on Hands pool on Yuki (the rain-dark surveyor). Honest engine returns; no fudging.

origin.universe: Contemporary Earth — Morenci Copper Mine, Arizona

blind_spots_specifics: Consecration field's effect on Divine Sense baseline (suggested_query: fire Divine Sense at 1/1 cost)
Names/classes/conditions of the four other cohort members (suggested_query: ask or wait for roll-call)
Mnehmos — entity is above the read's resolution
events.note: Cole's first honest use of his Operator subsystem. Returned partial commit + populated blind_spots. The Mnehmos blind-spot is the spec §7 boundary-of-perception payoff: the maker is above resolution from inside.

events.outcome: Four cohort members + Cole stepped clear of the keystone-aligned slabs
events.note: Administrative control surfaced via plain speech — the first cohort coordination act. No engine roll needed; physical compliance observed.
Plain-language query to the System; honest return.

events.engine_returned_effect: minor restoration; cold exposure mitigated at the margin, not eliminated; wet clothing remains active heat-loss hazard
events.honest_returns_note: Engine did not flatter. The wet clothing is still a hazard — Lay on Hands bought a margin, not a cure.

events.spoken: Cole Maddox. Morenci, Arizona. Heavy equipment.
events.note: First introduction to the cohort. Withholds the Paladin assignment.

events.message: NO XP THIS BEAT — first hour does not award; growth begins at the first earned risk
events.note: Canon for Bastion's growth model: earned risk, not participation.

ledger_state_at_chapter_end.yuki_state: moved closer to lamp-ring; rain-wet outer layer remains active hazard; received 1 hp Lay on Hands restoration (margin only)
ledger_state_at_chapter_end.chamber_state: post-rite cooling; under-floor channels still bleeding; 24 summoners still in stalls (2 with hand-tremor); Mnehmos has not descended; Severa signaled re: tremors but reaction not yet observed
